projects.title: Featured Engineering Projects
projects.subtitle: Selected applications demonstrating scalable architecture, real-time data handling, and fine-tuned UI performance.

items.name: ApexCart
items.subtitle: Next.js E-Commerce Engine
items.description: Next.js storefront with virtualized catalog rendering, optimistic cart state, and Stripe payment processing.
items.challenge: Rendering 10,000+ items smoothly on mobile without page-wide re-renders during cart updates.
items.solution: Implemented windowed list virtualization in React, decoupled cart state into Zustand fine-grained selectors, and added optimistic UI updates.
items.outcome: Achieved fluid 60fps scrolling and instantaneous cart feedback on all devices.
items.techStack: Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, Zustand, Tailwind CSS, Stripe API

items.name: SyncMed
items.subtitle: Real-Time Booking Portal
items.description: Healthcare scheduling platform featuring live slot synchronization, optimistic mutations, and offline draft recovery.
items.challenge: Preventing double-bookings under high concurrent traffic while preserving offline form drafts.
items.solution: Built optimistic slot locking with TanStack Query v5, integrated IndexedDB draft recovery, and handled API race conditions cleanly.
items.outcome: Zero booking collisions and full offline form preservation.
items.techStack: React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Query, IndexedDB, Context API, Framer Motion

items.name: VigilantFinance
items.subtitle: Analytics & Billing Dashboard
items.description: High-density data portal with reactive charts, client-side table virtualization, and URL-persisted filter states.
items.challenge: Filtering dense datasets without dropping frame rates during live chart interactions.
items.solution: Memoized reactive selectors, virtualized invoice tables, and mapped active filters to URL search params.
items.outcome: Zero frame drops and instant shareable view URLs.
items.techStack: React, TypeScript, Recharts, CSS Modules, Vite

items.name: SecureX Gate
items.subtitle: Authentication System
items.description: Enterprise-ready auth workflow with HttpOnly cookie tokens, silent session rotation, and tab-wide sync.
items.challenge: Eliminating XSS vulnerability vectors while maintaining seamless tab-wide session synchronization.
items.solution: Configured HttpOnly cookie proxy routing, protected route guards, and multi-tab BroadcastChannel event listeners.
items.outcome: Total token security with instant multi-tab signout synchronization.
items.techStack: React, TypeScript, HttpOnly Cookies, React Router, BroadcastChannel

items.name: TaskFlow Core
items.subtitle: Accessible Task Manager
items.description: Kanban workspace featuring fluid drag-and-drop, state machine hooks, and full keyboard navigation.
items.challenge: Delivering complex drag-and-drop interactions accessible via screen readers and keyboard shortcuts.
items.solution: Leveraged react-aria primitives, custom state machine hooks, and live aria region notifications.
items.outcome: Complete keyboard parity and seamless assistive technology support.
items.techStack: React, TypeScript, Custom Hooks, react-aria, CSS Modules

items.name: SearchEase Core
items.subtitle: Type-Ahead Search
items.description: Instant client-side search engine delivering sub-millisecond query lookups across thousands of records.
items.challenge: Filtering thousands of records dynamically per keystroke without UI stutter.
items.solution: Built a client-side prefix index structure paired with Framer Motion GPU-accelerated layout transforms.
items.outcome: Sub-millisecond query response with silky smooth UI reordering.
